reset: Defaults restored: environment variables now apply.
intro: Audit entries do not go into the trash. Set a retention period to limit their growth. Expired tokens are removed during the same cleanup.
auditHint: Older audit_logs entries are removed. Environment setting: {days} days.
cronHelp: Use five cron fields: minute, hour, day, month and weekday. Changes take effect without restarting the server.
cronInvalid: Enter five fields separated by spaces.
trashHint: Items older than this are permanently deleted. Environment setting: {hours} hours.
noSettings: No settings stored in the database
invalidDays: Audit retention must be a whole number from 1 to 3650 days.
invalidHours: Trash retention must be a whole number from 1 to 8760 hours.
invalidLogCron: The log schedule requires five cron fields.
invalidTrashCron: The trash schedule requires five cron fields.
